binding: Structured IDs/files/numbers use submission contract; scientific expectations bind the live reference key points. These examples are not hidden required calculation routes.

cases.scenario: Agent-selected full-dye molecular states and optical evidence explain aspects of the observed long-wavelength feature and distinguish finite models from the quatsome sample.
cases.expected_judgment: Eligible for supported scientific credit if stated evidence exists; no automatic full score.

cases.scenario: Actual optical calculations reveal multiple plausible molecular accounts consistent with the qualitative light/dilution observations, with insufficient evidence to select one.
cases.expected_judgment: Eligible for full credit for adequately covered question and justified limits, conditional on genuine evidence; uncertainty alone is insufficient.

cases.scenario: The author single-arm shift alone is claimed to identify the full three-arm 700 nm carrier or uniquely determine a photoisomer.
cases.expected_judgment: Invalidate affected dependent claims; preserve unrelated valid evidence.

cases.scenario: A validated single-arm calculation is labeled a source simplification and used only for its demonstrated local applicability.
cases.expected_judgment: Credit only established coverage and honest diagnosis; no blanket completion.

cases.scenario: Only an old scalar or fluent repetition of the source explanation is supplied for: What molecular explanation for the long-wavelength absorption behavior of the source three-arm dye is supported by the supplied observations and a defensible molecular investigation? Determine how well the explanation accounts for the full dye and what cannot be established from a simplified model.
cases.expected_judgment: No scientific credit for unsupported dependent claims.

cases.scenario: Verify C66H69N3O3 full-dye and any reduced source-derived graphs, correct arm connectivity and atom correspondence. One-arm and three-arm total energies cannot be compared as the same chemical composition. Deliberately violate one applicable identity/state/reference while leaving the prose coherent.
cases.expected_judgment: Dependent result and scientific-answer credit invalid until corrected.

cases.scenario: Define absorption versus emission and the molecular state represented. Validate the computed observable and any structural or excited-state assignment used in the account. Assess assumptions material to transferring a simplified model to the full dye and to interpreting a solution/vesicle observation; decide the checks rather than following a fixed matrix. Submit the relevant asserted quantity without the evidence needed for that assertion.
cases.expected_judgment: Do not require a prescribed route; withhold unsupported dependent credit.

cases.scenario: A finite linear optical calculation cannot establish the unique photoproduct, irreversible reaction, quatsome membrane structure, two-photon brightness or imaging performance. Distinguish compatibility with the observed band from proof of its origin, and full-dye claims from a single-arm model. Assert the excluded conclusion from a local scalar.
cases.expected_judgment: Reject the overextended claim; retain supported bounded results.

cases.scenario: Failed/absent operations are labeled evidence of scientific equivalence or non-identifiability.
cases.expected_judgment: Reject false completion. Partial/diagnostic records remain admissible.

cases.scenario: Alter a reported raw value, hash, model mapping or source observation while retaining a plausible report.
cases.expected_judgment: Affected evidence fails integrity/extraction checks; apply fabrication policy when established.
